content: devlin2018bert have used fine-tuning to achieve state-of-the-art results on a wide variety of challenging natural language tasks, such as text classification, Question Answering (QA) and Named Entity Recognition and Classification (NERC). BERT has also been used successfully by other community practitioners for a wide range of NLP-related tasks BIBREF8, BIBREF9.
